The region of the data management center for threat detection and response. Select the data management center based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: assets in regions outside China

ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域

AsocInstanceId.description_en: The Agentic SOC Credits instance ID. If SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY, this field returns the Credits subscription instance ID for prepaid orders. If SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_POST_PAY, this field returns the Credits pay-as-you-go instance ID. This field is empty if no Credits instance is found. For legacy orders, the Security Center instance ID is returned by SasInstanceId
AsocInstanceId.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 实例 ID。SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时，返回 Credits 预付费订阅实例 ID；为 CREDITS_POST_PAY 时，返回 Credits 后付费实例 ID。未查询到 Credits 实例时为空。老售卖订单的云安全中心实例 ID 由 SasInstanceId 返回

AsocSubscriptionInstanceEndTime.description_en: The end time of the Agentic SOC Credits prepaid subscription, expressed as a 13-digit Unix timestamp in milliseconds. This field is returned only when SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY. In other cases, this field is empty
AsocSubscriptionInstanceEndTime.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅的结束时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳，共 13 位。仅 SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时返回，其他场景为空

AsocSubscriptionInstanceStartTime.description_en: The start time of the Agentic SOC Credits prepaid subscription, expressed as a 13-digit Unix timestamp in milliseconds. This field is returned only when SiemOrderFrom is CREDITS_PRE_PAY. In other cases, this field is empty
AsocSubscriptionInstanceStartTime.description_zh: Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅的开始时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳，共 13 位。仅 SiemOrderFrom 为 CREDITS_PRE_PAY 时返回，其他场景为空

容量订单来源独立于 SiemOrderFrom 所表示的流量订单来源

SiemOrderFrom.description_en:
The source of the traffic order. Valid values:
PRE_PAY_FLOW: a prepaid traffic order for threat detection and response.
POST_PAY_FLOW: a pay-as-you-go traffic order for threat detection and response.
CREDITS_PRE_PAY: an Agentic SOC Credits prepaid subscription.
CREDITS_POST_PAY: an Agentic SOC Credits pay-as-you-go instance.

This field describes the traffic order source. The log storage capacity order source is independently indicated by CapacityOrderFrom
SiemOrderFrom.description_zh:
流量订单来源。取值：
PRE_PAY_FLOW：威胁分析预付费流量订单。
POST_PAY_FLOW：威胁分析后付费流量订单。
CREDITS_PRE_PAY：Agentic SOC Credits 预付费订阅。
CREDITS_POST_PAY：Agentic SOC Credits 后付费实例。

此字段描述流量订单来源；日志存储容量订单来源由 CapacityOrderFrom 独立表示

SiemOrderStatus.description_en:

SiemOrderStatus.title_zh:
